fusions.name: Herd Nip
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5.5 tiles (max +32%). You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Warm Stampede
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage and is knocked back 2.5 tiles. You regain 8 health.

fusions.name: Grazing Ground
fusions.desc: Creates a field within 4 tiles of you for 10 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Woolly Companion
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of nature that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.4s. Each kill it makes restores 3 health to you.
